name: EdgeErrorPage
title: Blocks/State/EdgeErrorPage
summary: The page Azion's edge serves to a visitor of a customer's site when a request fails: a standalone page, no Azion product chrome, no account actions. Left-aligned and diagnostic: the `StatusCode` with its reason phrase, a title in plain words, the request path You → Azion edge → Origin drawn with `FlowDiagram` `uniform` (every hop the same width and height, each with a `StatusIndicator`; stacked boxes of the same size on a phone), What happened? and What can I do? side by side, Try again or Go to home page with Go back, then the request details in a `KeyValueList` (request ID with `CopyButton`, `Timestamp` in UTC, edge location, host) and a Served by `Brand` footer. The primary is the 502 (origin unreachable); variants cover 504, 500, 503, 403 (blocked by the site's firewall), 429 and 404. Azion's own console, site and docs use `state/error-page` instead.

variants.name: OriginTimeout
variants.summary: 504: the edge reached the origin, but it did not answer in time. The origin hop reads Timed out; Try again and Go back.

variants.name: OriginError
variants.summary: 500: the origin answered with an error while building the page. The origin hop reads Error; Try again and Go back.

variants.name: OriginUnavailable
variants.summary: 503: the origin is down for maintenance or too busy. The origin hop reads Unavailable; the copy says the site usually comes back on its own.

variants.name: Blocked
variants.summary: 403: a firewall or WAF rule the site owner set on the edge matched the request, so it never reached the origin. The edge hop reads Blocked and the origin Not reached; Go to home page and Go back, and the advice is to contact the site owner with the request ID.

variants.name: RateLimited
variants.summary: 429: the visitor's connection sent more requests than the site allows. The edge hop reads Rate limited and the origin Not reached; wait a minute, then Try again.

variants.name: NotFound
variants.summary: 404: the origin has no page at the address. Every hop worked and the origin reads Not found; Go to home page and Go back.
